Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Reading 2.3 Guided Reading: Fluency (2 sessions) • Vocabulary building: colours 
Topic 2.5: Guided Reading: Vocabulary Building
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Reading: Vocabulary Building, part of Reading 2.3 Guided Reading: Fluency (2 sessions) • Vocabulary building: colours  in Grade 5 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: How do you spend your free time? 2. How does new vocabulary help in learning Arabic language?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. conduct a reader’s theatre on a short text related to the theme,

2. work jointly to identify vocabulary related to the theme,

3. team up with peers to prepare a mind map to outline various words related to the theme,

4. work jointly to identify meaning of the words,

5. practice reading the target words fluently. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. conduct a reader’s theatre on a short text related to the theme,
2. work jointly to identify vocabulary related to the theme,
3. team up with peers to prepare a mind map to outline various words related to the theme,
4. work jointly to identify meaning of the words,
5. practice reading the target words fluently. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Reading: Vocabulary Building together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

various words related to the theme.
